simple.meaning: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants ; figuratively, a flock
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַם (H5971) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 1870 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עַם (ʻam) means a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants ; figuratively, a flock First listed occurrence: 1Chr 5 25.
